positions.name: KnowledgeRemovalDirectives
positions.frame: what knowledge does the organization direct to be removed or forgotten from its record?
positions.why: Both expressions are directives issued by Xena ExpertGH targeting specific knowledge for erasure — one names the Quantum Widget Decision, the other names the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration. The shared directional read is the act of directing removal: what should be purged and why, read together as a coherent set of forgetting instructions.
